title: Feature Request
description: Structured feature request produced by Brainiac

title.description: Short, imperative name for the feature

problem_statement.description: Description of the problem or opportunity this feature addresses

proposed_solution.description: High-level description of the proposed approach to solve the problem

constraints.description: Technical, business, or time constraints that bound the solution

in.description: Capabilities explicitly included in the MVP

out.description: Capabilities explicitly excluded from the MVP

mvp_scope.description: Explicit in/out scope boundaries for the minimum viable product

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifiable conditions that must be true for the feature to be considered complete

risks.description: Known risks or unknowns that could affect delivery or correctness

effort_estimate.description: T-shirt size estimate of implementation effort

research_brief_path.description: Relative path to the research brief artifact produced alongside this feature request
